objective: Decision 0105: the effect pass. Each Shadow Legion enemy's power attack does what SHANNON asked (the Necromancer raises up to three, the Battle Priest heals its whole side, the dragons and the Siege Golem strike the whole team) and gets a power move and effects of its own.
acceptance_criteria: A Necromancer's power attack raises up to REVIVE_MAX fallen allies, each once a fight
A Battle Priest's power attack heals every ally standing; its normal attacks heal the one most hurt
A dragon's or the Siege Golem's power attack strikes every animal still standing; every other enemy's strikes one
Each enemy has its own power move and effects, picked by SHANNON from the concepts
verification: lune run tests/run (BattleRules); lune run tools/blender/stations/check_foe_powers (every power move through its clip); the power moves in Studio.
